title: 第五千六百二十四章 一个都走不掉下第五千六百二十三章 一个都走不掉中
lines: 一直到最后，肖平处理了那四名战友的后事之后，来到了部落中九阶大巫姬白负责的侦查部后，才恍然大悟。
只见山门外，一位身穿黄色长袍，满脸华贵之色的三皇子大笑的走来，在他身后，有上百的随从，其中的三皇孙也其中。
“圣主，我们走吧！
这样的待遇，在九玄天界是从来没有过的，你可算得上是九玄天界第一人！”
秦莫雨语气中不阴不阳的，沐阳也权当没听见。
要修炼身外化身，那是相当的困难。
魔皇闭关多年，甚至封锁魔族真么多年，也不过就是修炼出三重身。
这下倒好，一次就损伤两重身。
天辰被柳白灵的这句话惊出一身冷汗，连忙上前两步，打起圆场。
“那还不说！”
秦梦用手指点了点魏丑夫汩汩流血的伤口催促道。
那些在寻宝中庄稼被毁坏的世家大族，也不用过分担忧今年的食邑收成，因为来自邯郸的大商贾在此兴建了不少作坊，招纳了他们不少衣食无着落的百姓。
要炼制冰心丹，最主要的就是他们坚定的心境。
只要能够摒弃杂念，一心只为了帮助冰主压制体内的气息，便能够炼制出来，而且众人必须一心一意，不能分神。
有的是马腿被朴刀斩断，有的是控制不住身形，实惠的撞在鹿砦上。
秦国朝堂，众说纷纭，各个派系之间互相怀疑，可是都因为毫无头绪不了了之。
“对不起，我有点不太明白你们在说什么……郑家是什么家族，很厉害吗？还有，郑红棉是什么人？”
我丈二和尚摸不着头脑地问。
遍寻不着马雯，我又去到浴室里给马鸣打电话，电话嘟嘟两声，马鸣喂了一声，我正要说话，忽然见马雯出现在我后方。
原来她之前一直在角落里默默看着我。
红尘客栈的包间里，南宫白表情严肃的看着雷骁五人拿回来的战利品良久，众人大气不敢出，团长他老人家该不是气坏了要发飙吧？
自己身上的确背着很多秘密，背后又有天启那座大山压着自己，泄露秘密就等于找死。
但在这种情况下，他也实在无法编出一个足够圆润的谎话。
李原宇虽然纳闷我的吞吞吐吐，不过，这家伙也是一个知道好歹的，他也明显感觉到了气氛有些不对。
这家伙真的听了我的话，也是不太高兴出门了。
content_en:
It was not until the end, after Xiao Ping dealt with the funeral affairs of the four comrades and came to the investigation department in charge of Ji Bai, the ninth-level witch in the tribe, that he suddenly realized what was going on.
Outside the mountain gate, a third prince wearing a yellow robe and a regal face came laughing. Behind him, there were hundreds of followers, including the third prince's grandson.
"Holy Lord, let's go!
This kind of treatment has never been seen in Jiuxuan Heaven Realm. You can be regarded as the number one person in Jiuxuan Heaven Realm! "
Qin Moyu's tone was neither yin nor yang, and Mu Yang pretended not to hear it.
It is quite difficult to cultivate the incarnation outside the body.
The Demon King has been in seclusion for many years, even sealing off the Demon Clan for so many years, but he has only been able to cultivate a triple body.
This is good, as it will damage both bodies in one go.
Tianchen was startled by Liu Bailing's words and broke into a cold sweat. He quickly took two steps forward to smooth things over.
“That’s not to say yet!”
Qin Meng pressed his finger on Wei Choufu's bleeding wound and urged.
Those aristocratic families whose crops were destroyed during the treasure hunt don't have to worry too much about this year's food harvest, because the big merchants from Handan have built many workshops here, recruiting many of their people who have no food and clothing.
To refine the Bingxin Pill, the most important thing is their firm state of mind.
As long as you can abandon distracting thoughts and focus solely on helping the Ice Lord suppress the aura in your body, you can refine it, and everyone must concentrate on it and not be distracted.
Some horses' legs were cut off with a simple knife, and some horses couldn't control their body shape and crashed into the deer village.
In the Qin court, there were divergent opinions, and various factions were suspicious of each other, but they all stayed silent because they had no clue.
"I'm sorry, I don't quite understand what you are talking about... What kind of family is the Zheng family? Is it very powerful? Also, who is Zheng Hongmian?"
Monk Zhang Er asked confused.
Ma Wen was nowhere to be found, so I went to the bathroom to call Ma Ming. The phone beeped twice and Ma Ming said hello. I was about to speak when I suddenly saw Ma Wen appear behind me.
It turned out that she had been watching me silently in the corner.
In the private room of Hongchen Inn, Nangong Bai looked at the trophies brought back by Lei Xiao and the others for a long time with a serious expression. Everyone was so angry that they didn't dare to show it. The leader, the old man, must be so angry that he wants to go crazy?
He does carry a lot of secrets on his body, and there is the mountain of Apocalypse pressing on him behind him. To reveal the secrets is to seek death.
But in this case, he really couldn't make up a smooth enough lie.
Although Li Yuanyu was puzzled by my hesitation, this guy also knew what was good and what was good, and he clearly felt that something was wrong in the atmosphere.
This guy really listened to what I said and was not too happy to go out.
